summary.text: Ramona Goolsby, a Republican family nurse practitioner, Army Reserve veteran and elected soil and water conservation district supervisor, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of New Mexico to Amanda López Askin.
She campaigned on election integrity, voter ID, cleaner voter rolls and enforcement of campaign finance laws.

paragraphs.text: Goolsby served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1999 to 2004 and worked more than 30 years as a nurse, most recently as a primary care provider for the Veterans Administration.
She came to New Mexico in 2019 after retiring as a nurse practitioner and rancher, according to Source NM.
In November 2025 she was elected to the Ciudad Soil and Water Conservation District Board of Supervisors.
She received 39.1% of the vote to Amanda López Askin's 60.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
